university.summary: ICN Business School welcomes 900 international students annually across its campuses in Nancy, Paris, and Berlin, offering exchange programmes for the 2026/27 academic year. The school is ranked 67th globally by the Financial Times 2025 and holds triple accreditation (AACSB, AMBA, EQUIS).
strengths:
- Triple accredited business school (AACSB, AMBA, EQUIS)
- Ranked 67th best business school in the world (Financial Times 2025)
- 80+ nationalities represented
- 52% international faculty
- 43% international student body
- Strong international network with 140 partner universities in 40 countries
- Paris La Défense campus offers direct access to 2,800 major companies
- Berlin campus inaugurated in 2025, located in Moabit district near start-ups
facilities:
- 360° virtual tours available for Paris, Berlin, and Nancy campuses
- Nancy campus: vibrant cultural environment, strategic location in Europe's third-largest student city by 2026
- Paris La Défense campus: located in Europe's fourth largest business district with access to CAC 40 companies
- Berlin campus: natural setting along River Spree with numerous parks, close to world-leading start-ups
